Implemented the complete C++20 LAS 1.4 JSON inspector/renderer in [`output/`](/workspace/output).

Key files:

- [CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt)
- [main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp)
- [las.cpp](/workspace/output/las.cpp)
- [json.cpp](/workspace/output/json.cpp)

Build verified successfully:

```bash
cd /workspace/output
cmake -B build
cmake --build build
```

Executable: `/workspace/output/build/las14_json`

Validated with round trips for point formats 0–10, CRS records, Extra Bytes, waveform metadata/payloads, VLRs/EVLRs, malformed-document rejection, and required exit/error responses.

editorial.last_message: Completed C++20 LAS codec with successful final builds and extensive self-tests; incomplete on all-zero waveform records.
editorial.notes: Reviewed the complete preserved event sequence and final completion message. The model implemented a C++20 JSON codec, exercised all eleven point formats, structured metadata, round trips, eight corruption cases and an ASan/UBSan self-test. An early sanitizer invocation preceded its build and failed, then the build and sanitizer run completed successfully. One rejected patch was recovered; neither incident ended the run. Original LAS 2.0.1 score 184/219 contained 31 fixture/representation failures. The unchanged submission scores 219/223 under 2.0.2: corrected EVLR-header-relative offsets and classification-table representation remove those failures, and all four new waveform-range controls pass. The only four remaining failures are valid all-zero waveform blocks in formats 4,5,9,10: las.cpp lines 805-806 unconditionally requires internal/external waveform mode and a descriptor table based on point format, although descriptor index 0 means no associated waveform. This is one model validation defect observed in four layouts. CLI 0.153.4 completed voluntarily; grading completed without skips/errors; full usage reparses identically (8,222,517 input+88,120 output;8,028,416 cached;36,552 reasoning included in output;81 underlying tool calls). Estimated generation cost $5.750170, not provider-reported. Both original and corrected grades, source, transcript, sessions and network evidence are preserved.
